h1.en: Electric 20 vs Diesel 30 Concrete Pump is a catalogue comparison, not a page from Electric motor
h1.zh: 电动20和柴油30混凝土泵有何不同是目录对照，不是「电动机」那一页

directAnswer.en: Electric 20 and Diesel 30 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 20 lists 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm and distance 120 m / 40 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_motor.
directAnswer.zh: 电动20和柴油30是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动20标出 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、管径 80 mm、骨料 1–2 cm、距离 120 m / 40 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_motor。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_motor. Subject: VEM motor Wernigerode. Electric 20 and Diesel 30 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Theoretical output: Electric 20 lists 8–10 m³/h. Diesel 30 lists 15 m³/h. Max. aggregate size: Electric 20 lists 1–2 cm. Diesel 30 lists 3 cm and below. Electric 20 lists entries that Diesel 30 does not: Motor power 22 kW. Delivery pipe diameter 80 mm. Read each H / V label on its own page. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_motor。画面主体：VEM motor Wernigerode。电动20和柴油30是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。最大出口压力：电动20标出 10 MPa；柴油30标出 20 MPa。外形尺寸：电动20标出 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm；柴油30标出 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。120 m / 40 m 里的先后，和 60 m / 180 m 不是同一种大小关系。

body.en: Electric 20 lists 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm and distance 120 m / 40 m. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 20 lists 10 MPa. Diesel 30 lists 20 MPa. Dimensions: Electric 20 lists 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm. Diesel 30 lists 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. Diesel 30 lists entries that Electric 20 does not: Diesel engine power 4105 / 56 kW. Open /en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/ for Electric 20 and /en/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 30.
body.zh: 电动20标出 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、管径 80 mm、骨料 1–2 cm、距离 120 m / 40 m。料斗容积：电动20标出 0.25 m³；柴油30标出 0.3 m³。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看电动20请打开 /zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/，看柴油30请打开 /zh/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Diesel 30 lists 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, aggregate 3 cm and below and distance 60 m / 180 m. Hopper capacity: Electric 20 lists 0.25 m³. Diesel 30 lists 0.3 m³. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 柴油30标出 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、骨料 3 cm 及以下、距离 60 m / 180 m。输送距离（水平/垂直）：电动20标出 120 m / 40 m；柴油30标出 60 m / 180 m。电动20有、柴油30没有的行：电机功率 22 kW；输送管内径 80 mm。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: The pages do not share a pipe-diameter entry. Pumping distance (H / V): Electric 20 lists 120 m / 40 m. Diesel 30 lists 60 m / 180 m. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. The order inside 120 m / 40 m is not the same pattern as 60 m / 180 m. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 理论输送量：电动20标出 8–10 m³/h；柴油30标出 15 m³/h。最大骨料粒径：电动20标出 1–2 cm；柴油30标出 3 cm and below。柴油30有、电动20没有的行：柴油机功率 4105 / 56 kW。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 20 list the same theoretical output as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 电动20和柴油30的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 lists 8–10 m³/h. Diesel 30 lists 15 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动20标出 8–10 m³/h。柴油30标出 15 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 20 list the same max. outlet pressure as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 电动20和柴油30的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 lists 10 MPa. Diesel 30 lists 20 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动20标出 10 MPa。柴油30标出 20 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 20 list the same hopper capacity as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 电动20和柴油30的料斗容积一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 lists 0.25 m³. Diesel 30 lists 0.3 m³. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动20标出 0.25 m³。柴油30标出 0.3 m³。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is motor power missing on Diesel 30?
question.zh: 为什么柴油30没有电机功率？

answer.en: The Diesel 30 page does not list that label. Electric 20 lists 22 kW. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_motor.
answer.zh: 柴油30这一页没有标出这个标题。电动20标出的是 22 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_motor画面里印出的数字。
